zh.title: 台灣民航局公布中秋及光復節連假離島航線訂位時程
zh.summary: 民航局宣布中秋第二波及光復節連假離島機票將於下週開放訂位
body: 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月21日宣布，為滿足民眾在中秋節及教師節連假期間的返鄉與旅遊需求，針對目前需求較高之澎湖及金門航線，已規劃第二波加班機及放大機型，並定於8月26日（下週三）上午9時起統一開放訂位。此次加班機預計將為離島航線額外注入運能。
根據民航局規劃，本次中秋及教師節的第二波加班機總計將提供7,384個座位數。其中，澎湖航線提供4,920個座位數，金門航線則提供2,464個座位數。民航局提醒旅客，此兩大節日的正班機及第一波加班機已於7月27日開放訂位，本次是針對需求較高的航線進行運能補充，建議旅客儘早規劃行程並依航空公司規定期限完成開票。
除了中秋及教師節連假，民航局也於8月20日宣布了2026年光復節連假的航空疏運計畫。2026年光復節連假自10月24日至10月26日共計3天，民航局將10月23日至10月27日規劃為共計5天的航空疏運期，並以澎湖、金門及馬祖等三離島管制航線為疏運重點，自8月24日（下週一）上午9時起統一開放訂位。
在光復節連假的運能分配方面，民航局共規劃了1,072架次，計87,268個座位數。具體航線分布為：澎湖航線提供458架次、33,116個座位數；金門航線提供480架次、45,072個座位數；馬祖航線則提供134架次、9,080個座位數。民航局已要求航空公司持續注意訂位狀況，並將視實際需求適時增開班次。
為確保運能有效利用，民航局強調兩次連假的尖峰時段機票均設有使用限制與退票分級制。中秋及教師節連假的限制時段為9月24日至26日（台灣出發往離島）及9月27日至29日（離島往台灣）；光復節連假限制時段則為10月23日至25日及10月25日至27日。上述機票均會加註「限當日當班次」及「逾期作廢」之使用限制，退票費用將分三階段收取。
另外，作為票價與營運背景，民航局先前曾於2026年8月3日宣布，由於國際航空燃油價格近期上漲，國籍航空公司之國際航線客運燃油附加費自8月9日起調漲。其中短程航線由27.5美元調漲為30美元，長程航線由71.5美元調漲為78美元。民航局當時要求業者充分揭露相關資訊，以維護消費者權益。

en.title: Taiwan CAA Announces Booking Dates for Mid-Autumn and Retrocession Day Holiday Flights
en.summary: Taiwan CAA announces booking opening dates for upcoming holiday flights to offshore islands.
body: On August 21, 2026, the Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of Taiwan announced that booking for the second wave of extra flights and larger aircraft models for the upcoming Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holidays will open on August 26 (Wednesday) at 9:00 AM. This initiative is designed to meet the high travel and homecoming demands of the public for the islands of Penghu and Kinmen.

According to the CAA, the second wave of holiday flights will provide a total of 7,384 seats. Specifically, the Penghu route will offer 4,920 seats, while the Kinmen route will provide 2,464 seats. The regular flights and the first wave of extra flights for these holiday periods had previously opened for booking on July 27, 2026. The CAA advised passengers to complete ticketing within the deadlines specified by the airlines to secure their bookings.

In addition to the Mid-Autumn and Teachers' Day arrangements, the CAA announced on August 20, 2026, the transport plan for the upcoming Retrocession Day holiday. This holiday, spanning three days from October 24 to October 26, 2026, will feature a five-day aviation transport period from October 23 to October 27, 2026. Ticket bookings for the three major offshore island routes of Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu will open on August 24 (Monday) at 9:00 AM.

For the Retrocession Day holiday, a total of 1,072 flights and 87,268 seats will be provided across the three offshore island routes. The capacity allocation includes 458 flights and 33,116 seats for the Penghu route; 480 flights and 45,072 seats for the Kinmen route; and 134 flights and 9,080 seats for the Matsu route. The CAA has requested airlines to closely monitor booking statuses and arrange additional flights as needed.

To ensure the efficient utilization of transport capacity, the CAA emphasized that peak-hour tickets for both holiday periods will be restricted. These restrictions apply to departures from Taiwan to offshore islands during the initial peak days and returns to Taiwan during the latter peak days. Affected tickets will be restricted to the designated date and flight, becoming invalid if expired, and will be subject to a tiered refund fee system.

As part of broader regulatory activities, the CAA previously announced on August 3, 2026, that passenger fuel surcharges for international flights operated by domestic airlines would increase starting August 9, 2026, due to rising aviation fuel prices. Short-haul international route fuel surcharges rose to $30, while long-haul surcharges increased to $78. The CAA had requested carriers to fully disclose this information to safeguard consumers.
